CCEA Double Award Science mark scheme 'Quality of written communication' guidance (Summer 2025 P1 H MS pp.2-3, docs/sources/papers/science/2025-Summer/P1-H-Physics-MS-67250.txt) and the Q3 band table (p.4)

legal: Descriptors are rewritten in our own words; the band labels (Band A/B/C, 'Response not worthy of credit') and the mark ranges are kept exact.

specRequirement.text: The specification requires candidates to (1) write legibly with accurate spelling, punctuation and grammar so that the meaning is clear, (2) choose a form and style of writing that suits the purpose and the complex subject matter, and (3) organise information clearly and coherently, using specialist vocabulary where appropriate.
specRequirement.where: One question carrying 6 marks in each of B1, B2, C1, C2, P1, P2 and in each Booklet B (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) — nine per Summer series.
specRequirement.how: A three-band scheme that states the minimum number of indicative-content points for each band; the quality of written communication then decides the mark within the band.

bands.label: Band A
bands.contentThreshold: five or six (or 'at least five') of the listed indicative points, described in detail
bands.descriptor: Excellent use of scientific terminology: the answer uses the most suitable form and style, is organised with a high degree of clarity and coherence, uses specialist vocabulary widely and accurately, and its presentation, spelling, punctuation and grammar are good enough that the meaning is clear throughout.
bands.source: Summer 2025 P1 H MS p.3 (detailed band guidance) and p.4 (Q3 band table); corpus scan 2026-09-05

bands.label: Band B
bands.contentThreshold: three or four of the listed indicative points, described in detail
bands.descriptor: Good use of scientific terminology: a reasonable choice of form and style, material organised with some clarity and coherence, some specialist vocabulary, and presentation, spelling, punctuation and grammar competent enough for the meaning to be clear.
bands.source: Summer 2025 P1 H MS p.3 and p.4; corpus scan 2026-09-05

bands.label: Band C
bands.contentThreshold: one or two of the listed indicative points
bands.descriptor: Basic reference to scientific terminology: only a limited choice of form and style, organisation that may lack clarity and coherence, little specialist vocabulary, and presentation, spelling, punctuation and grammar that may leave the intended meaning unclear.
bands.source: Summer 2025 P1 H MS p.3 and p.4; corpus scan 2026-09-05

bands.label: Response not worthy of credit
bands.source: Summer 2025 P1 H MS p.2 ('Band D') and Q3 table ([0]); corpus scan 2026-09-05

withinBandPlacement.threshold: An answer that only just qualifies for the band is placed at or near the bottom of the range.
withinBandPlacement.high: An answer that fully satisfies the band description is placed at or near the top.
withinBandPlacement.source: Summer 2025 P1 H MS p.2 (Levels of response: threshold performance / high performance)

indicativeContent.typicalPointsListed: 6 to 8 bullet points per question (Summer 2025 P1 H Q3 listed 7)
indicativeContent.note: The single [5]-[8] range is an 8-mark banded question (an outlier); every other banded question in the corpus is worth 6.

stemRubric.ourWords: This question also assesses the quality of your written communication, including your use of specialist scientific terms.
stemRubric.note: Every QWC question in the papers carries a standard sentence to this effect and the front page names the QWC question ('Quality of written communication will be assessed in Question 3'). Items reproduce the format, not the sentence.
stemRubric.source: Summer 2025 P1 H paper front page and Q3; Summer 2025 U7 Physics Booklet B paper Q1(a)

examinerNotes.text: Capital letters and full stops are part of the quality judgement; a list of fragments caps the band.
Write inside the boxed area in black ink; legibility affects the within-band mark.
Use the specification's terms exactly (nuclei not atoms; helium as the product of fusion; 'carry charge' not 'carry current').
examinerNotes.source: research 03 §7.3, §7.4 (fusion QWC Summer 2025 P1; NaCl conduction C1 H)

examinerNotes.text: Points are only counted if they answer the question asked; an unscaffolded QWC on the March 2026 C1 paper produced confused, off-target answers.
A correct point contradicted elsewhere in the answer is not counted (the listing principle applies to prose).
